name: Joan AI (Joan Workplace management Agent)
description: Joan AI is a smart chat assistant with real workplace skills. Built on MCP, it gives AI real workplace management powers — booking desks and rooms, organizing team setups, and handling routine workplace requests automatically.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Joan AI (Joan Workplace management Agent) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Joan AI (Joan Workplace management Agent) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.getjoan.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Joan AI (Joan Workplace management Agent) MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Joan AI (Joan Workplace management Agent) lists 55 MCP tools, including checkin_desk_reservation, checkin_room_reservation, checkout_desk_reservation, checkout_visitor, create_amenity, create_announcement, create_asset, create_asset_reservation, create_asset_type, create_desk_reservation, create_room_reservation, and create_visitor_invitation.

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Joan AI (Joan Workplace management Agent) in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Joan AI (Joan Workplace management Agent) MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Joan AI (Joan Workplace management Agent) requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Joan AI (Joan Workplace management Agent)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Joan AI (Joan Workplace management Agent) is developed by Joan by Visionect. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
